uno_q_primary: other official Arduino UNO Q repositories

input.connector_family: Phoenix Contact 2-pos 5.08 mm pluggable terminal block

official_supported_inputs: regulated 5 V through JANALOG 5 V pin / up to 3 A
host_power.source_note: Official Arduino GitHub docs-content confirms VIN is buck-converted to 5 V and diode-OR'd with USB-C into 5V_SYS. The regulated JANALOG 5 V pin is also a supported host power input.
nfb_architecture_decisions: Use protected 12 V into VIN as the baseline host-power method.

Do not tie the shield-local 5V_RAIL to the UNO Q 5 V pin in the baseline, although Arduino officially supports that pin as a regulated 5 V input; separation is intentional to avoid shared-load transients and back-feed paths.
Do not tie shield-local 3V3_RAIL to UNO Q PWR_3P3V; use it only if a future PR deliberately proves current budget and sequencing.
Never drive IOREF; use it only as a high-impedance host-ready/reference signal.

regulator.emi_note: TI specifies CISPR 11 Class B compliant-capable with appropriate layout/filtering.

enable.purpose: keep shield 5V off until UNO Q 3.3V/IOREF is alive

shield_3v3.reason: preserve independent shield power domain and avoid accidental back-feed; not because UNO Q lacks a 3.3V output

power_sequence: 12V_PROTECTED -> J_UNOQ VIN; UNO Q boots from its own power tree
UNO Q IOREF rises to 3.3 V -> enable U_5V
Only then are shield field sensors/HMI and 3.3V logic energized

power_budget.note: The 60 W adapter provides margin for UNO Q transient load, HMI/sensors and pump+solenoid. Chiller power is external.

actuator_policy.dirty_return_rule: 12V_ACT returns must join GND at power-entry/star region and must not cross Z1/Z2 return paths

compliance_rules: Keep switching regulator and 12V_ACT physically in Z3/Z4, away from Z1 analog and UNO Q RF keepout.
Use continuous reference plane; do not route switching-node copper on internal reference plane.
TVS and eFuse must be adjacent to the power-entry connector.
Do not connect shield-local 5V_RAIL to UNO Q 5V pin or shield-local 3V3_RAIL to UNO Q 3V3 pin unless a future reviewed PR changes the architecture.
Use IOREF only as a high-impedance enable/reference signal; never back-feed it.
Final input filter and IEC 61000-4-5 pre-compliance values require bench/lab validation.
